changes.evidence: In S6#11 (From the Ashes) Izel draws on Yo-Yo's and Mack's memories and they involuntarily create Flint; in S6#12 Izel breaks his leg and they get him to the Zephyr, where Yo-Yo promises to show him the world. Fandom lists him as her 'Creation and Friend'.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#22
proposed.text: Enoch and his men burst into the diner where Coulson's team waits to be arrested, and he freezes them all and has them taken away.

changes.evidence: World's End (S4#22) ends with the abduction on screen: Enoch greets 'Phillip J. Coulson', says 'The window closes in two minutes. Take them' and freezes the team (Wikipedia's S4 cast lists Joel Stoffer as Enoch). The S5#1 stage (sending them to 2091) can stay. Kind ally because he is acting to save them, even if they don't know it yet.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#9

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Friend who helps build Coulson's L.M.D. body, and dies at his side.

changes.evidence: As I Have Always Been (S7#9): Enoch pulls out his Electrochron Displacement Mechanism to repair the Time Drive, and Coulson and Daisy stay with him and mourn as he deactivates. The current text leaves out his death, the main event between them there.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#6
proposed.text: Enoch offers Jemma up to the Chronicom hunters to make Fitz cooperate, then turns on his own people and rescues her and Fitz.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Agent Enoch first betrays to the hunters, then rescues.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Chronicom who betrays Jemma to the hunters, then rescues her and Fitz.

changes.evidence: Not S4/S5 (there Enoch only abducts the team as a group). The connection really starts in S6: they meet on Kitson in S6#3; in The Other Thing (S6#5) Enoch tells Atarah 'Put Jemma Simmons in danger, and Fitz can do anything'; in Inescapable (S6#6) he deactivates Atarah and the hunters and teleports Fitz and Jemma out.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#6
proposed.text: Enoch offers Jemma up to the Chronicom hunters, and a furious Fitz throws him out of his cell, but Enoch then turns on his own people to rescue them both.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Best friend Enoch betrays, then rescues from the hunters.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Chronicom who betrays Jemma to the hunters, then rescues Fitz and her.

changes.evidence: S4 pass (Fitz is frozen with the group; the 'not on the list' moment is shown later). But between S5#5 and S6#13 there is a clear betrayal and reconciliation: S6#5 Enoch gives Jemma up to Atarah and Fitz, furious, orders him out of his cell; S6#6 Enoch takes 'bold action' and rescues them.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#7

now.on_a_card_about_b: Agent Enoch rescues on the ruined surface of Earth in 2091.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Chronicom who sends the team forward and rescues May in 2091.

changes.evidence: Enoch is not in S5#7 (Fandom's appearance list: S4#22, S5#1, S5#5, then S6). He never rescues May in 2091. In Know Your Onions (S7#2) he tells May they have not met. Their first real scene together is S7#1, when he heals her in the pod (the next stage).

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#2

now.on_a_card_about_b: Trusted friend Enoch heals, and once stops with an I.C.E.R.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Trusted friend who heals May, and once draws an I.C.E.R. on her.

proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Agent Enoch heals, who beats him when he tries to stop her with an I.C.E.R.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Chronicom who heals May, then draws an I.C.E.R. to stop her leaving.

changes.evidence: Know Your Onions (S7#2): May wakes too early, stabs Enoch with the sedative, and when he aims an I.C.E.R. to keep her aboard she fights him and bludgeons him until Coulson stops her, calling him 'just a machine'. Nothing there shows him becoming a 'trusted friend'.

changes.evidence: A.K.A. Everything (S3#13): Jessica tells Erik she knows he is a good guy but can't trust him; he leaves, and Costa, sent by Jessica, offers him work with the police. The romance ends.

owner_calls.question: Add a stage for S5#11, where Piper's secret deal with General Hale puts the team in the trap where Ruby cuts off Yo-Yo's arms?
options: Add a stage at Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#11 (kind ally): Piper's deal with Hale leads the team into the ambush where Ruby cuts off Yo-Yo's arms, and Piper blames herself.
Leave it: Piper was lied to and sided with the team, so the friendship doesn't clearly turn.
owner_calls.evidence: All the Comforts of Home (S5#11): Piper had cut a deal with Hale. When it comes out she helps the team escape, but Ruby slices off Yo-Yo's arms, and Piper sits alone thinking about her own part in it. In S5#12 she is held in a cell, begging to make amends.
